---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a change that fits the current architecture
labels: enhancement
---

## Motivation

The problem or use case this change addresses.

## Proposal

What should change and where. Identify the owning package or the new ownership
boundary if one is required.

## Impact

Which layers or boundaries are affected, and what storage or protocol
compatibility consequences (reset or migration) the change introduces.

## Alternatives considered

Why this approach rather than another.
